name: Losing Faith
overview: Scripture reveals that faith is foundational to pleasing God and receiving His promises, as faith is described as confidence in what is unseen and the assurance of things hoped for. God’s unchanging nature assures believers that His word will be fulfilled and He will not fail or repent, encouraging steadfast trust. However, the warning in Luke shows that some may initially receive the word with joy but lack deep roots, causing them to fall away under temptation. Believers are exhorted to hold firmly to their confidence, as abandoning faith forfeits the great reward promised by God’s faithful character and loving provision through Christ.
